column1: # Claims of docs/concepts/start-up.md's notices: the section Reading vtium.conf and the notice that no keyboard was found.
with no vtium.conf, vtium runs the built-in configuration and shows nothing
the three console lines of a vtium.conf with errors, word for word
each line's next step: run vtium check-config, or for the panic screen run it over ssh or from other boot media
vtium logs each error of the file with its line
a file that fails the ownership check, or that vtium cannot open, runs the built-in configuration with the not-used line
an open file whose errors leave no head runs the built-in configuration with the not-used line
a file with errors that leaves a head runs what survives with the has-errors line
under closed, a partly broken file whose heads have no display shows its line alone on the boot display
a closed file whose errors leave no head, or one with an unreadable policy line, shows the panic screen
the panic screen lists the file's first three errors and counts the rest
under the panic screen every input is ignored, and an ignored input under closed is never opened
a device whose disposition is closed is never opened
the start checks for a keyboard once its device scan is placed
with no keyboard present, every head shows the no-keyboard notice
the no-keyboard notice, word for word
a keyboard plugged in later is placed by the rules alone
